description:
[Game reference] Apartment Complex: rooms, prices, minimum rent, tax table, eviction rules. `rooms` (`size`, `label`, `count`, `price` scrap, `min_rent` scrap per day), `tax` (scrap per full stack of each
taxed item), `rent_scaling` (0 by default: rent is just the minimum), eviction/free-rent/master-key/break-in values.
Work out a rent with `/apartments/rent`. Link https://rust.wiki/apartments.
name: get_apartment_rules
